---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement or a new feature
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What problem would this solve, and for whom?

## Proposed solution

Describe the desired behavior. Include a UI sketch, archive-format example, or
plugin interaction when helpful.

## Alternatives considered

Which other approaches did you consider, and why do you prefer this one?

## Components and compatibility

Which components are affected: Chrome, iOS, ChatGPT/Codex, PDF conversion,
archive format, or documentation? Could the change affect existing archives,
GitHub permissions, privacy, or security?

## Additional context

Add links or synthetic examples that help explain the request. Do not include
private archive content or material you do not have permission to share.
